def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is one file name: non-empty, no '/' or '\\', and not '.' or '..'."""
    ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("../x") == False
    ex is_plain_name("sub/a.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    if "/" in name or "\\" in name:
        return False
    return True

def read_note(name: str) -> str | None uses fs:
    """Text of notes/name read through fs, or None when the file is missing or unreadable.
    Only plain file names are read; the read is confined to the notes directory."""
    pre is_plain_name(name)
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        text = fs.read_text(name) else return None
    return text

def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the first name in names that reads from notes, or "" when none does.
    Names that are not plain file names are skipped, never opened.
    Reads happen only inside notes, through fs narrowed with fs.sub("notes")."""
    post out.byte_len() >= 0
    for name in names:
        if not is_plain_name(name):
            continue
        text = read_note(name)
        if text is not None:
            return text
    return ""
